allow: Bash(python3.12 -c "import aiofiles; import aiohttp; import pandas; print\('deps OK'\)")

hooks.command: jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // .tool_response.filePath // empty' | { read -r f; case "$f" in *.py) [ -x .venv/bin/pytest ] || exit 0; out=$(.venv/bin/pytest tests/ -q 2>&1); [ $? -eq 0 ] && exit 0; printf '%s' "$out" | tail -6 | jq -Rs --arg f "$f" '{systemMessage:("pytest failed after editing "+$f),hookSpecificOutput:{hookEventName:"PostToolUse",additionalContext:("pytest tail:\n"+.)}}';; esac; } 2>/dev/null || true
